title: clusterMap of tpg-delete-instance
description: The clusterMap input of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-delete-instance: registered clusters, their keys and their instances. Generated from workflows/params/cluster-map-keys.yaml by workflows/params/clustermap_schema.py; the validate step of the workflow is the authority (registered clusters, required values an input may supply, combinations of values).

instances.description: The instances of the cluster (namespace: the key namespace of tpg-day0 and tpg-create-instance, default pg-<instance>); at least one

postgresVersion.description: tpg-day0, tpg-create-instance and tpg-upgrade: the version to deploy or upgrade to. Guard in the other workflows: when set, an instance that runs another version is skipped (SKIPPED_VERSION_MISMATCH) and nothing is changed for it [String (version); guard (skip an instance that runs another version)]

purgePvcs.description: As the input: delete the volumes [Boolean; optional (default: the input purgePvcs)]

purgeNamespace.description: As the input: delete the namespace (needs purgePvcs true). Refused (NAMESPACE_SHARED) while another instance of clusters/fleet.yaml, or another Postgres, uses the namespace; tpg-delete-apps deletes a shared namespace after the last instance of the run, and with deleteOperator whoever else is there [Boolean; optional (default: the input purgeNamespace)]

finalBackup.description: As the input: true (a final backup, best effort), false (none) or required (fail when the instance is not Running) [Enum; optional (default: the input finalBackup)]

purgeBackups.description: Round 23. tpg-delete-instance, tpg-delete-apps: as the input - expire every PostgresBackup of the instance while it runs, then delete every blob left under its container and repoPath after it is gone (irreversible; needs finalBackup false; a repoPath another PostgresBackupLocation on any registered cluster uses is expired only, blobs kept and reported). tpg-backup-expire: true expires every backup of the instance and never deletes blobs; not together with backups [Boolean; optional (default: the input purgeBackups)]
